input_object: ow_tp.bronze.custbill_raw WHERE ns=? (record_kind='BODY' is parsed; HDR/TRL rows feed the trailer check). Fixture seed: `python3 scripts/tp_dbx/custbill.py seed-fixture --layer bronze --ns <ns> --legacy-root <root>`.
golden_baseline_location: Regenerated: `make legacy-etl-gen-data NS=<ns>`, `make legacy-etl-run JOB=sftp_ingest_poll`, `make legacy-etl-run JOB=parse_custbill_fixedwidth` under `OTTERWORKS_LEGACY_ROOT=/home/ubuntu/otterworks-legacy-<ns>` via scripts/tp-run-deterministic.sh. Baseline = `parsed/CUSTBILL*.psv` (6 pipe-delimited fields, 50 rows per file, 100 total). Anomaly baseline = `make legacy-etl-gen-history NS=<ns> START_YEAR=2023 END_YEAR=2023 ROWS_PER_MONTH=40` manifest `sftp-drop/history/expected/<ns>-history-expected.json` (`planted_anomalies`).

declared_source_volume.anomaly_seed: gen_history_data.pl 2023 → 12 files × 40 rows with per-file planted rows listed in the manifest

record_layout_copybook_CBCUST01.cust_id: cols 1-10 PIC X(10) → trim trailing spaces → STRING
record_layout_copybook_CBCUST01.cust_name: cols 11-40 PIC X(30) → trim trailing spaces → STRING
record_layout_copybook_CBCUST01.bill_date: cols 41-48 PIC 9(8) YYYYMMDD → DATE (strict calendar; legacy reformatted blindly to YYYY-MM-DD)
record_layout_copybook_CBCUST01.bill_amt: cols 49-60 PIC 9(10)V99 implied decimal → DECIMAL(12,2) = digits/100 exactly (no float; legacy awk `$4+0` then `%.2f`)
record_layout_copybook_CBCUST01.rec_type: cols 64-65 PIC X(2) (01 invoice, 02 credit) → STRING, untrimmed

steps: Select BODY rows for ns from bronze; slice by byte offsets above (raw_line is ASCII per ingest contract, so character offsets == byte offsets; assert this).

Validate: length(raw_line) >= 65 else quarantine `short_record`; cols 49-60 all digits else `nonnumeric_amount`; cols 41-48 a real calendar date else `invalid_calendar_date`. A row with several defects gets one quarantine row per defect (reasons are a set).

Trailer check per file: TRL count (cols 4-13, leading zeros stripped) vs BODY row count; mismatch → one quarantine row per file with line_no = TRL line_no, reason `trailer_count_mismatch`; body rows are STILL loaded (finance parity with legacy requires it).
Load: DELETE FROM silver/quarantine WHERE ns=? AND source_file IN (files in this run) then INSERT; natural key (ns, source_file, line_no) unique in silver. Never DDL.

HDR/TRL: any BODY-classified line whose raw_line starts with HDR or TRL does not exist by construction (ingest classifies); if a line starting HDR/TRL appears mid-file it is HDR/TRL kind and excluded from silver — identical to the legacy `sed '/^HDR/d;/^TRL/d'`.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: ASCII rows from bronze (FACT for fixtures); EBCDIC coverage gap pending R1
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: cust_id/cust_name/currency: trailing spaces trimmed (legacy `gsub(/ +$/,"")`), leading spaces and interior bytes preserved; rec_type not trimmed; bill_amt/bill_date typed
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: a non-ASCII byte inside a fixed field is kept verbatim in silver STRING columns; offsets are byte-based

malformed_record_policy.details: Fixed-width has no delimiters: a `|` inside CUST-NAME is data (legacy PSV would have shifted fields — a legacy defect, the target keeps it as data and the recon canonicalises by re-splitting the legacy PSV positionally when a name contains `|`; the clean seed contains none). Lines longer than 65 bytes: bytes 66+ ignored (legacy `cut` behaviour). Short lines → quarantine `short_record`, attributed to (source_file, line_no). Empty fields → empty STRING, never NULL, except bill_date/bill_amt which are NULL only in quarantine rows (silver never holds NULL).

empty_input_semantics.details: No BODY rows for ns → 0 silver, 0 quarantine rows, task succeeds (legacy wrote an empty .psv). A file with HDR+TRL(0000000000) only → 0 rows, no trailer mismatch.

planted_anomalies.description: YYYY0231 in cols 41-48 → quarantine reason invalid_calendar_date, row excluded from silver.
`00000ABC1234` in cols 49-60 → quarantine reason nonnumeric_amount, row excluded from silver (legacy coerced to 0.00).
TRL count != body count → one file-level quarantine row; body rows loaded.

planted_anomalies.reason: No generator produces a short line; behaviour specified (quarantine short_record) and unit-tested with a hand-made line in the child's tests, but not present in the seeded anomaly set.

acceptance_checks.description: count(*) silver WHERE ns=? == total PSV rows (100 on clean seed); per source_file 50.

Full row diff: silver (cust_id,cust_name,bill_date ISO,bill_amt '%.2f',currency,rec_type) ordered by (source_file,line_no) == legacy PSV lines in file order; 0 mismatches (T4 strings byte-exact after trailing-space trim, T3 dates, T2 money).
Quarantine WHERE ns=? on clean seed == 0 rows (T7).
Trailer: for each file TRL count == BODY count on clean seed; assertion recorded per file.

Anomaly leg on the 2023 history seed: set of (file,row,kind) from quarantine == manifest planted_anomalies set (missing=∅, unexpected=∅) (T8); silver excludes exactly the invalid_calendar_date and nonnumeric_amount rows.
Idempotency: rerun on same bronze → identical silver/quarantine counts and identical row diff result (T9).

deficiencies_retired: three-pass cut/sed/awk with no validation → typed columns with expectations and quarantine
implied decimal via awk float → exact DECIMAL(12,2)
trailer logged, never reconciled → file-level trailer_count_mismatch quarantine
/tmp/cb_body.$$ temp files, stale lock → none; max_concurrent_runs=1
output overwritten on duplicate basename → natural-key upsert per (ns, source_file, line_no)
